{{Quote|Tch. Tch. Zssss. Memory fails. Since lost sixsister of hive mind, much less RAM, memory very poor.|A member of the species, attempting to have Roark Garnet pay them for information|<ref name="TRG1" />}}
A '''species''' of [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Grasshopper/Legends|grasshopper]]-like beings produced sound and speech by rubbing together their [[Limb/Legends|legs]]. Members of the [[Species/Legends|species]] shared several bodies via single [[Hive mind/Legends|hive mind]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], one such [[Alien/Legends|alien]] worked as a [[Bartender/Legends|bartender]] and at one point sold information to the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Roark Garnet/Legends|Roark Garnet]].

==Biology and appearance==
A [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] beings had bodies of<ref name="TRG1" /> the size and<ref name="SWS2" /> visual appearance of [[Grasshopper/Legends|grasshoppers]]. They produced sound by rubbing together their [[Limb/Legends|legs]], with [[Language/Legends|speech]] thus produced having an audial quality of a [[Violin/Legends|violin]] [[Music/Legends|concerto]]. In addition, one member of the species was able to kick [[Plastic/Legends|plastic]] [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credit]] [[Credit token|tokens]] with the speed of a [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] being fired.<ref name="TRG1" /> Members of the species displayed [[Hive mind/Legends|hive intelligence]],<ref name="SWS2" /> with several bodies sharing the same consciousness&mdash;an arrangement that allowed for efficient cooperation in performing various tasks.<ref name="TRG1" />

==Society and culture==
The [[Alien/Legends|aliens]] identified as belonging to at least one&mdash;female&mdash;[[Gender/Legends|gender]].<ref name="TRG1" />

==The species in the galaxy==
{{Quote|Tch. Yesss. Farseeker herenow seven hours since gone. With large tentacled alien of model unknown to me&hellip;|The alien bartender|<ref name="TRG1" />}}
[[File:RoarkGarnet.jpg|thumb|right|230px|Roark Garnet once bought both a beverage and information from a member of the species.]]
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], one [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]]-speaking member of the species&mdash;consisting of at least three individuals linked through a hive-mind&mdash;worked as a [[Bartender/Legends|bartender]]. At one point, the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Roark Garnet/Legends|Roark Garnet]] ordered a [[Foodstuff/Legends|beverage]] at the establishment where the bartender worked and, observing with fascination the alien entities' coordinated movements, asked them for information on the whereabouts of the retired Imperial [[Captain/Legends|captain]] [[Jackson Farseeker]].<ref name="TRG1" />

The bartender claimed that, ever since losing their hive mind's "sixsister," their memory had become impaired, which prompted Garnet to correctly guess that giving the being an amount of credits would persuade them to share information with him. The bartender then relayed to the smuggler that they had seen Farseeker depart in the company of a [[Unidentified tentacled alien|tentacled alien]].<ref name="TRG1" />

==Behind the scenes==
The species was first mentioned in the [[1987]] [[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|rulebook]] for the first edition of [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="TRG1" />
